_comment: Website-side collection presentation seed (visibility + order + optional copy/images). Product membership comes ONLY from Square's Collection attribute. Live edits persist in Cloudflare KV via /admin/collections → PUT /api/collections-config. New Square collections with no entry default to visible=false. Public pages require visible=true AND productCount > 0.

entries.description: Spellbound motifs, midnight flora, and a little woodland witchcraft for everyday carry.
Celestial charms, moonlit motifs, and starry keepsakes for night owls and sky watchers.
Creatures and quiet hours — moths, moonlight, and the soft magic after dark.
Forest friends, fungi, and rooted evergreen energy for people who feel most at home outside.
Salt air, marsh light, and coastal flora — pieces that feel like a pocketful of the shore.

Little tributes for the companions who make every ordinary day softer.
